name: Arabic
description: The 28 manazil al-qamar (lunar mansions) of Arabic astronomy, identified with their stars.
source: Wikipedia, "Lunar station", Arabic manzil table (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lunar_station), citing D. Adams, "Arabic Star Catalog", Two Deserts One Sky, Univ. of Arizona
Stars not in constellations.json taken from HYG v4.1 (github.com/astronexus/HYG-Database)
license: Wikipedia text: CC BY-SA 4.0; HYG v4.1 data CC BY-SA 4.0. Stellarium arabic_lunar_stations, arabic_ancient and arabic_al-sufi (Khalid al-Ajaji) are CC BY-ND 4.0 (special permission only to Stellarium Labs) and were deliberately NOT used or adapted. al-Balda (the "Wasteland", an empty region near pi Sgr) has no stars and is omitted.

figures.name: ash-Sharatan
figures.story: Manzil 1 of the 28 Arabic lunar mansions; star identification follows the table in Wikipedia "Lunar station" (an alternative identification is noted there for some mansions). Stars are joined in the order listed; these are marker lines, not a historical stick figure.
